title: Betrouwbaarheidsanalyse en het additieve schaalmodel  1970 : Vaardigheidscursus data-analyse
authors: Weegh, P.H.M. op de, Kerssemakers, F.A.M., Hutjes, J.M., Instituut voor toegepaste sociologie, ITS * Nijmegen (primary investigator)

descriptions: A course on data analysis/ in particular analysis on reliability and the additive scale model. For secondary analysis part of a survey on the ideas of teachers in secondary education about their jobs is used / this survey is also complete stored in archive see P0174
